name: Ilocos Sur Esports Bot
desc: Discord bot for the Ilocos Sur Provincial Government's esports league during the Ilocos Sur Festival. It verifies players against team rosters and ties each bracket to Challonge.

p: A Discord bot for the esports side of the Ilocos Sur Festival, built for the Ilocos Sur Provincial Government. The league ran Mobile Legends and Call of Duty Mobile, and the bot handles who plays for which team and keeps the brackets in step with Discord. It also covers support tickets, auto-created voice channels and scheduled announcements.
[Why this was built, in a sentence.]

Staff post a verification panel with /verifypanel. A player picks a game role, chooses their team and types an in-game name, and the bot renames them to match. Staff add and manage teams with /teams. A marshal or admin links a Challonge bracket to a channel, and the bot lists open matches and reports each result back to Challonge. Players, teams and rosters sit in MySQL.
